query:
SELECT jtw.event_id, t.name as tree_name, jtw.percentage
        FROM juicing_tree_weights jtw
        JOIN juicing_events je ON je.event_id = jtw.event_id
        JOIN events e ON e.id = je.event_id
        JOIN trees t ON t.id = jtw.tree_id
        WHERE e.batch_id = ?
        ORDER BY t.name
